title: Lifecycle & Freshness Governance v2

review_queue.interpretation: Current queue is a verification queue. Out-of-stock is not treated as discontinued and does not trigger redirects, canonical changes, status changes, or freshness-date writes.

governance_assets.trigger: intent conflict, duplicate URL attempt, material routing change
source invalidation, manufacturer evidence change, new first-party evidence
decision rule change, compatibility schema change, tool-route change

acceptance_basis: Static regression gate passed on the Phase 23 v2 implementation.
Authenticated WordPress/WooCommerce live audit completed successfully on main.
Sanitized live evidence was persisted to the repository.
All dependency and anti-fake-freshness checks passed.
No commerce or content mutation was performed by the audit.

items: Review the 206 P2 out-of-stock products as a supply-state verification queue when business operations require it.
Do not infer discontinuation from this queue without explicit evidence.
Re-run governance when lifecycle evidence, canonical ownership, compatibility rules, or source validity materially changes.
